$sources: IS 1905:1987 Code of practice for structural use of unreinforced masonry
source: IS 1905:1987: unreinforced masonry walls by permissible stresses from the basic compressive stress of the units and mortar, the stress reduction factor of slenderness and eccentricity, the area and shape factors (method basicStress). The earthquake detailing, high wind rules, anchor bolts, confined masonry and the reinforced masonry values are BNBC 2020's (the pack this one extends), named so.

strengthening.note: IS 4326 read through the parent's arrangement rows (alpha 9 C9b): zones III and IV as the parent's middle group, zone V as its highest.

clauses.seismic: IS 4326:2013 (earthquake resistant design and construction of buildings)

sources.basicStressIS: IS 1905:1987 Table 8: basic compressive stress fb [MPa] by the compressive strength of the units (3.5 to 40 MPa) and the mortar grade H1, H2, M1, M2, M3 (cement : sand 1:3, 1:4, 1:5, 1:6, 1:7 of Table 1); linear between the unit strengths; the lime mortars L1, L2 are not entered
sources.stressReductionIS: IS 1905:1987 Table 9: ks by SR 6-27 and e/t 0, 1/24, 1/12, 1/6, 1/4, 1/3, linear between; '-' where e/t 1/3 meets SR 26-27
sources.shapeIS: IS 1905:1987 5.4.1.3, Table 10: kp = 1 for units with height to width up to 0.75 (common bricks); SAEngine takes 1 for every unit (overridable)
sources.effectiveHeightIS: IS 1905:1987 Table 4: 0.75 H for walls with floors or roofs bearing on them or RC slabs at both ends (SAEngine practice: taken for every wall supported top and bottom, overridable); 2 H with a free top
sources.slendernessIS: IS 1905:1987 4.6.1: SR at most 27 for walls in cement or cement-lime mortar (lime mortar: 20 up to two storeys, 13 above: not entered)
sources.eccentricityIS: IS 1905:1987 5.4.1.4: with e/t above 1/24 the compressive stress at the face due to the eccentric load may be 25 % above fc
sources.tensionIS: IS 1905:1987 5.4.2: flexural tension 0.07 MPa normal to the bed joints, 0.14 MPa parallel to them, for mortars of grade M1 or better (1:5); none with leaner mortars
sources.lateralIS: IS 1905:1987: the permissible stresses with wind or earthquake taken 25 % higher (the value to verify)
sources.seismic: IS 4326:2013 (alpha 9 C9b, read through the parent's arrangement rows): the earthquake strengthening of masonry buildings by seismic zone: mortar only in zone II; bands at plinth, lintel and roof level, vertical bars at the corners and junctions (and the jambs of openings above two storeys) and the roof bracing in zones III-V, the zone V bars as the parent's highest zone. The band and corner bar sizes, the opening shares and the reinforced-wall ratios are the parent's (BNBC 2020 Part 6 Ch 7 follows IS 4326; to verify against IS 4326 Tables, VERIFY.md). IS 4326's building categories A-E by zone and importance and its opening limits by the number of storeys (0.50, 0.42, 0.33 of the wall) are not modelled
